messages:
maria_csm: Heads-up 10 customers in this week's onboarding batch left structured feedback. Mostly billing clarity and a couple of infra hiccups causing session drops. Can we triage and get quick wins out?

sasha_csm: Sharing summarized notes + raw sheet. Common asks: 'per-route cost breakdown', 'session keepalive', and 'better getting-started examples for reranking'.

maria_csm: Two accounts (BrightLeaf, SolvCo) flagged as at-risk in CRM because they hit timeouts during long prompt sessions. Both mentioned confusing token spikes when routes overlap.

aj_product: Thanks. Suggest we do a 2-stage response: immediate CS-facing fixes (docs + admin CSV export) and infra hotfix for timeouts. Longer term: per-route billing UI and reranking examples in docs.

leo_se: Investigated BrightLeaf logs. Connection drops correlate with intermittent KV cache compaction during long sessions. Quick mitigation: increase LB idle and add keepalive by default on onboarding fleet for 48-72h. I'll open a change and put flag behind a config.

nina_enablement: If we do a temporary keepalive toggle, I can run a short enablement email + 10-minute webinar to walk customers through best practices. That should reduce churn perception.

feedback-bot: Labels applied: [onboarding], [billing-clarity], [infra-timeouts].

aj_product: For the admin CSV export: propose an endpoint that returns rows: customer, route, tokens_incurred, timestamp_range. No UI for now. CS can drop to customers while UI is scoped. Who can own?

leo_se: I can ship an admin-only CSV export by mid-week. Small endpoint + auth gate.

sasha_csm: I'll draft a one-pager showing how to interpret the CSV for customers (mapping routes -> features). Also will add a note to pause renewal emails for SolvCo until we confirm fix.

maria_csm: Can product create a lightweight priority tag for "renewal-risk" so CS can flag tickets that should jump the queue? Right now those get stuck in backlog.

aj_product: Yes. I'll add a triage field to the ticket template: priority_reason (renewal-risk|security|ops), customer_impact_score (1-5). Use that to sort the backlog.

nina_enablement: Also proposal: record a 5-minute clip on "avoiding token spikes" for onboarding playbook and attach to trial invites. I can produce it this week.

leo_se: Plan summary: 1) bump LB idle & enable keepalive on onboarding fleet (48h toggle) - PR in next 24h; 2) admin CSV export - endpoint in 2 days; 3) infra root cause follow-up (KV compaction) - longer ticket.

aj_product: I'll make the triage ticket and assign initial owners. Please add estimated effort and ETA in the ticket.

sasha_csm: Done tagging entries and creating a CS board column "onboarding-quick-fixes". Pinging account owners to expect outreach.

maria_csm: Thanks all. Let's reconvene Friday EOD if any customer still sees timeouts. If not, we can close loop and move per-route billing to Q2 planning. :rocket:
